mechanism_narrative: The recent collapse in WORKPLACES mobility is a leading indicator of weaker discretionary trips, so retail and recreation will remain below its prior 4-week mean over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC averages above its last-28-day mean over the next 28 days despite WORKPLACES staying below the prior week level or below zero change.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL mobility is elevated while TRANSIT stays depressed, trips are being replaced by stay-at-home behavior, which reduces retail visits within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT remains below -10 points while RESIDENTIAL stays above +8 points
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 14 days even though TRANSIT stays below -10 and RESIDENTIAL stays above +8 for most of that period.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rebound in PARKS mobility above baseline signals reopening and larger out-of-home activity, which spills over into higher retail-and-recreation visits over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS crosses from negative to positive week-on-week
failure_condition: PARKS stays positive but RETAIL_REC fails to exceed its prior 4-week mean over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GROCERY_PHARM and RETAIL_REC proxy foot-traffic recovery; if grocery and pharmacy errands strengthen first, discretionary retail should follow within one week.
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM remains near or above its current level but RETAIL_REC does not increase within 7 days.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT continues to weaken while RESIDENTIAL remains elevated, commuting substitution is still active and retail mobility will decline further over the next month.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -12 points after already being below -10 points for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days even though TRANSIT remains below -12 and RESIDENTIAL stays above its recent mean.

mechanism_narrative: A one-week surge in PARKS mobility followed by normalization often precedes short-lived retail gains from weather-driven outings, so RETAIL_REC should improve over the next two weeks and then fade.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by at least 5 points from the prior week
failure_condition: PARKS rises by at least 5 points but RETAIL_REC does not improve within 14 days or improves only after the 2-week window.

mechanism_narrative: In a reopening regime, simultaneous improvement in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT indicates restored daytime circulation, which should lift retail-and-recreation mobility over four weeks.
failure_condition: WORKPLACES and TRANSIT recover together but RETAIL_REC does not exceed its previous 4-week average over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: Because RETAIL_REC already weakened while WORKPLACES and TRANSIT deteriorated in the latest week, the next four weeks should show continued retail underperformance unless those two series reverse first.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC turns above its last-28-day mean even though WORKPLACES and TRANSIT do not recover from their current weak levels.
